name: schezwan chilli chutney
ingredients_raw: Fruits & vegetables [41.0% (tomatoes, red chillies (14.0%), garlic, onion, ginger)], water, sugar, refined soyabean oil, liquid glucose, iodised salt, stabilizers (INS 1442, INS 415), flavour enhancer (INS 621), acidity regulator (INS 260), soyabean sauce [water, soyabean, wheat, iodised salt, acidity regulator (INS 260), flavour enhancers (INS 627, INS 631) and preservative (INS 202)], natural flavouring substances, schezwan pepper (0.1%), preservative (INS 211) and white pepper powder.
